name: Dai Gyakuten Saiban -Naruhodou Ryuunosuke no Bouken-
original_name: 大逆転裁判 ‐成歩堂龍ノ介の冒険‐
source:
[i]The Great Ace Attorney: Adventures[/i] is an an [i]Ace Attorney[/i] prequel game. Unlike previous canonical games in the series, which are set in the near future and feature somewhat futuristic technology, this game is set near the end of Japan's Meiji period, when the profession of "defense attorney" was still a fairly new concept in Japanese society. The game stars Phoenix Wright's ancestor, Ryunosuke Naruhodo, as well as a judicial assistant named Susato Mikotoba. Although the game initially takes place in Japan, the two later travel to the United Kingdom and work cases alongside the renowned detective Herlock Sholmes.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Dai_Gyakuten_Saiban:_Naruhodou_Ryuunosuke_no_Bouken]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
translation:
[i]逆转裁判大冒险[/i] 是一款[i]逆转裁判[/i] 前传游戏。与该系列之前的经典游戏以近未来为背景并具有一定的未来科技不同，该游戏的背景设定在日本明治末期，当时“辩护律师”这一职业在日本社会还是一个相当新的概念。游戏主角是菲尼克斯·赖特的祖先成步堂龙之介，以及司法助理须佐人美琴羽。虽然游戏最初发生在日本，但两人后来前往英国，与著名侦探赫尔洛克·肖尔姆斯 (Herlock Sholmes) 一起侦破案件。

[摘自[url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Dai_Gyakuten_Saiban:_Naruhodou_Ryuunosuke_no_Bouken]逆转裁判维基[/url]]
